archetypes.name: workflow-erasure
archetypes.rationale: Targets missed HARD/SIMPLE references and accidental retention across implement-only surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that the plan fully removes implement-side HARD/SIMPLE workflow plumbing without disturbing explicitly preserved design behavior. Check whether every producer, renderer, run-log, and report-tokens path named in scope has a coherent before/after contract and no stale fallback path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: env-leakage
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on polluted environment and legacy artifact leakage risks called out by the plan.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the plan for gaps in preventing ambient design environment variables, stale run-flags, old ledgers, or historical timing JSON from leaking workflow labels into implement reports. Compare proposed caller changes, fallback gates, and tests to ensure the isolation story is complete. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: report-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Checks report-tokens and summary shape changes for schema, heading, and issue-trim consistency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the planned report shape changes remain internally consistent across markdown tables, JSON appendices, golden fixtures, issue trimming labels, docs, and scan behavior. Look for schema drift, unthreaded skill parameters, or mismatched headings between implement and design modes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
